title: Sweet Naengmyeon French Dessert
description: A unique dessert inspired by Korean naengmyeon, with a French twist using sweet ingredients.
instructions: Boil the naengmyeon noodles according to the package instructions.
Mix the quaint fruit puree with the Korean sugar syrup.
Scoop the mixed fruit puree into a serving dish.
Place the cooked naengmyeon noodles on top of the puree mixture.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Top the noodles with the whipped cream.
Slice the vanilla bean and sprinkle the seeds on top.
Chill the dessert in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
